relations.subject: August Wilhelm von Schlegel
relations.role: Professor of Literature and Art History
relations.evidence: Still in 1818 he was invited to become the Professor of Literature and Art History at the newly founded Prussian University of Bonn, which he soon turned into a chair of Indology.

relations.subject: August Wilhelm von Schlegel
relations.evidence: Together with his student Lassen he developed Bonn into the first centre of Indology in Germany.

relations.subject: Lassen
relations.evidence: Among his students Lassen (1827), Fr. Windischmann (1832) and Delius (1838) passed Ph.D. under him, further also Gildemeister and Stenzler.
